presentation.name: Translate a metric between SQL and DAX without changing the number
presentation.summary: Rewrites an existing metric from SQL into DAX or from DAX into SQL, and treats the result as unchecked until the same grain and filters return the same number.
benefits: Refuses a guessed formula when the grain, the filters, or the date are not known
Writes the assumptions down and marks each one as stated or assumed
Keeps a ratio, a snapshot, a time comparison, and a join fan-out as different numbers from a plain sum
Labels a translation unchecked when it cannot be run at the same grain, filters, and population
